propositions: Four AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT firings on 2026-08-12 missed the DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX bound by 10–130 seconds (deferred_for values of 1810s, 1820s, 1810s, 1930s against a 1800s bound), each killing an in-flight LLM review and occurring at 10x the normal rate during a 60+ merge landing burst.
The original 1800s bound was sized as 1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS; raising it to 2400s (2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) absorbs the observed 10–130s overshoots and prevents all four Aug-12 interrupts.

The raise is bounded to a fixed multiple of the app's per-review cap to ensure self-adjustment when REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS changes and to avoid deferring kills indefinitely under sustained queue saturation.
The pinned relationship test must be tightened from >= 1.0x to >= 2.0x DEFAULT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and updated explicitly rather than deleted, enforcing the new bound relationship going forward.
Whether the Aug-12 episodes were saturated (with in_flight oscillating without reaching zero) remains unestablished; a larger bound only defers the same kill under saturation, not prevents it.

The terraform change is comment-only, requiring no operator apply; code changes are confined to infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh (DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX default and rationale comment) and the test (pinned relationship and docstring).
